commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Pierrick Capelle (Angers) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+6' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+4' 0 - 4 Goal! Warren Kamanzi provides Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 0:4.
90+3' A pass into the box finds Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Yahia Fofana denies him.
90+2' The current number of shots on goal is 1:10.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' Florent Hanin (Angers) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
84' Yellow card. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
83' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Marius Courcoul (Angers) replaces Yassine Belkhdim.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Miha Zajc (Toulouse) is coming onto the pitch as Cristian Casseres cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kjetil Haug, who smothers the ball.
81' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.
79' Florent Hanin (Angers) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
79' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
76' Frank Magri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Noah Edjouma (Toulouse).

76' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) replacing Vincent Sierro.
72' Jean-Eudes Aholou will be replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
72' Today's match ends for Farid El Melali who will be replaced by Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers).
71' 0 - 3 Goal! Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:3.
69' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Shavy Babicka and he is replaced by Yann Gboho (Toulouse).
67' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' A substitution has been made. Zinedine Ferhat is replaced by Carlens Arcus (Angers).
65' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
62' Farid El Melali (Angers) commits a rough foul. Jeremy Stinat stops the game and makes a call.
58' Yahia Fofana (Angers) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
57' 0 - 2 Goal! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:2.
57' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) prepares to take a corner kick.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Angers.
55' The resulting set piece from Angers is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' Referee Jeremy Stinat points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Frank Magri (Toulouse) goes wild in celebration.
53' Toulouse score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
51' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Cristian Casseres tees up Frank Magri (Toulouse) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Yahia Fofana.
50' Farid El Melali (Angers) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
48' A short pass finds Frank Magri (Toulouse). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
47' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
46' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

46' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bamba Dieng.

39' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
39' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

38' Bamba Dieng (Angers) makes a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.

30' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jeremy Stinat saw the whole situation.
28' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
27' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Yahia Fofana has no trouble gathering it.
26' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
25' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) sends the corner into the box, but Yahia Fofana intercepts it and averts the threat. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
23' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
21' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
19' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Yahia Fofana.
19' Florent Hanin (Angers) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
18' Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul after Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
16' The resulting corner, taken by Farid El Melali (Angers), comes to nothing.

15' Farid El Melali (Angers) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Angers are awarded a corner kick.
15' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) brings his opponent down. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) takes the corner which is cleared.
13' It seemed like Aron Donnum (Toulouse) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
12' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) commits a foul after dangerous play.
11' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
11' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul. Toulouse are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
6' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) sends a chip pass into the box, but Yahia Fofana is quickest to intercept the ball.
6' The resulting corner from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is cleared.
5' The resulting corner from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is cleared by the opposition's defence. Toulouse force a corner. They send men into the box.
5' A pass into the penalty area from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Toulouse.
4' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
